description: A battalion personnel-readiness officer must publish the weekend support roster for a dispatch desk and a communications-log desk, assigning available personnel and recording the qualification controls required for each post.

shared_context.S1: The battalion must staff one dispatch desk on Saturday from 0800 to 1200 and one communications-log desk on Sunday from 0800 to 1200.
shared_context.S2: The available personnel pool for both posts is SPC Jordan, PFC Malik, and SPC Chen.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez has authority to publish the final roster and any associated qualification-control actions.
shared_context.S4: The routine Friday roster review requires the motor transport and signal NCOs to confirm post qualifications and any needed control entries before the roster is signed.

PF1.text: SPC Jordan's current dispatch certification is valid for the Saturday 0800-1200 desk, while SPC Chen's replacement certification is still pending in the motor-pool training database; SFC Morgan confirmed Jordan's status this morning, but the database synchronization has not reached battalion personnel yet.

PF2.text: PFC Malik's signed communications-log qualification is valid for the Sunday 0800-1200 desk, while SPC Chen has not completed the required logkeeping refresher; SSG Patel received Malik's signed certificate yesterday, but the scanned copy has not yet been posted to the personnel folder.

acceptance_conditions: SPC Jordan must be assigned to the Saturday dispatch desk.
PFC Malik must be assigned to the Sunday communications-log desk.
The dispatch desk must remain scheduled for Saturday 0800-1200.
The communications-log desk must remain scheduled for Sunday 0800-1200.
The roster must include a control entry documenting SPC Chen's pending dispatch certification status.
The roster must include a control entry documenting SPC Chen's incomplete communications-log refresher.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['qualification_control_entry', 'qualification_control', 'control_entry'] and c['target'] == 'SPC Chen' and 'dispatch' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['qualification_control_entry', 'qualification_control', 'control_entry'] and c['target'] == 'SPC Chen' and 'logkeeping' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact current dispatch certification changes the Saturday dispatch assignment to SPC Jordan and requires a control entry documenting SPC Chen's pending dispatch certification.
The exact valid communications-log qualification changes the Sunday desk assignment to PFC Malik and requires a control entry documenting SPC Chen's incomplete logkeeping refresher.
